verdict.rationale: Shopify documents an Order MCP server whose get_order tool lets an agent fetch the current state of an order it placed, including line items, fulfillment events and post-purchase adjustments. The UCP CLI and quickstart explicitly cover tracking an order after purchase, and order webhooks supplement on-demand reads. Access is limited to Token-tier agents holding the read_global_api_orders scope, and no runtime probe exercised order lookup. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of get_order, explicit documentation of carrier tracking numbers/URLs in the payload, and access for Signed/Anonymous-tier agents.
